# More customers, less busywork: small business marketing and software in Houston
Websites, business software and AI chatbots, plus the local SEO, Google Maps and ads that bring you customers. Built for Houston small businesses.
Pacific Marketing Solution offers small business marketing and software in Houston from one team: a marketer who has grown small businesses and an engineering lead who has shipped 50+ software platforms. You get one plan, one point of contact and clear numbers every month.
Free · No contract · Reply within 24 hours
Free 30-minute call on Google Meet · or call +1 (832) 240-0846
Businesses we have worked with
Based in Houston, working with small businesses across the US and worldwide.

## Running a small business shouldn’t mean chasing every lead yourself
Most owners we talk to feel the same three pressures.

### Customers can’t find you
Competitors show up on Google Maps and in search results while you don’t, so people who are ready to buy call them first.

### Leads slip through the cracks
Calls go to voicemail, website messages wait for days and nobody follows up. Every missed reply is a sale you already paid to attract.

### Your tools don’t talk to each other
Booking, invoicing, a CRM and a website that each work alone mean hours of copying data and no clear view of what is working.

### One team that builds your tools and brings you customers
Most agencies do either the tech or the marketing. We do both, so your website, software and ads are planned and measured together. Everything is delivered online, with Google Meet calls and shared progress updates, whether you are in Katy or Kuala Lumpur.

#### We build
- Websites that load fast and turn visitors into calls
- Business software: booking, CRM, point-of-sale tools and dashboards
- AI chatbots that answer questions and book appointments around the clock

#### We grow
- Local SEO and Google Maps visibility
- Social media content and paid ads on Meta and Google
- Monthly reports on leads, calls and cost per customer

## Questions Houston business owners ask us
Q: How much do marketing and software cost for a small business in Houston?
It depends on scope, and you get a fixed quote in US dollars before any work starts. After the free growth plan call we send a written plan with the price, so there are no surprises.
Q: How soon will I see more calls or bookings?
Ads and chatbots often bring new enquiries within a few weeks, while local SEO usually builds over three to six months. We report calls, leads and bookings every month so you can see the trend.
Q: Can you build custom software like a booking system or CRM?
Yes. Our engineering team builds booking systems, CRMs, point-of-sale tools and dashboards, and connects them to the apps you already use.
Q: Do I have to sign a long-term contract?
No. Projects have a fixed scope, and monthly services can be stopped with notice, so you stay because the work pays off.
Q: Which Houston areas do you serve?
We serve all of Houston and nearby cities, including Katy, Sugar Land, The Woodlands, Pearland, Cypress, Spring and Pasadena. Most of the work happens online, so you never need to drive across town.
Q: Do you work with businesses outside Houston?
Yes. We work with small businesses across the US and in other countries, and everything from planning to reporting happens online.
Q: How do you work with clients in other time zones?
We schedule Google Meet calls at times that suit you and share progress in writing, so you can review updates whenever your day starts. Prices stay in US dollars, and we can quote in other currencies on request.

Page title: Digital Marketing Services | Pacific Marketing Solution
Address: https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/services/
Summary: Explore our twelve services: marketing, SEO, AI automation, chatbots, websites, analytics, software development, integrations and cloud.

# Twelve services that work alone or together.
Start with one, or combine them into a single growth system.

## All of our services

### AI automation and CRM
Leads should never depend on someone remembering to copy a row into a spreadsheet. We set up a CRM that captures every enquiry, sorts it and triggers the next step automatically.

### Chatbots and voice agents
An assistant that answers common questions at any hour, collects the details you need and books time in your calendar. It hands over to a person when needed.

### Performance marketing and funnels
Paid campaigns and landing pages designed around one goal: qualified enquiries at a cost you can justify. We track each step so you can see what is paying off.

### Content, creative and video
Consistent content is hard to keep up. We plan it, produce it and reuse it across channels, with people directing the work and AI speeding it up.

### Social media management
We plan, publish and manage your social channels on a steady schedule, reply to your audience and report what is working.

### Websites and apps
Clear, quick sites and landing pages that make the next step obvious, plus web apps when a page is not enough.

### SEO, AEO & GEO
We improve how your website ranks in search and how AI answer tools find, understand and cite it.

### White-label services
We deliver SEO, websites, content and advertising behind the scenes, under your brand name, as part of your team.

### AI analytics and data intelligence
We turn scattered business data into dashboards, reports and forecasts your team can trust and act on.

### SaaS and custom software development
We design and build SaaS products, web applications, dashboards and customer portals to fit how your business works.

### API and systems integration
We connect your CRM, payments, AI tools and business systems so data moves between them reliably, without manual copying.

### Cloud, DevOps and infrastructure
We deploy, secure and monitor your applications and servers so your website and software stay fast, available and recoverable.

## Questions before you choose a service.
Short answers on where to start and how the services fit together.

### Can I hire you for just one service?
Yes. Many projects start with a single website, campaign, assistant or CRM setup, and you can add more later.

### Which service should I start with?
It depends on your biggest problem. Not enough enquiries points to performance marketing and a landing page, slow replies point to a chatbot, and messy follow-up points to CRM automation. A discovery call helps us pick.

### Do the services work together?
Yes. The twelve services are designed to connect, for example ads feed a landing page, an assistant answers questions and the CRM keeps the follow-up going.

### How is the work priced?
Projects are scoped after a discovery call, based on what you need and the tools involved. We agree the scope with you before work begins.

### Do you work with small businesses?
Yes. We shape the work around your goals and budget and start with the change that matters most.

## Ready to talk it through?
Tell us what you are trying to achieve and we will suggest where to begin.

Page title: AI Automation & CRM Setup | Pacific Marketing Solution
Address: https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/services/ai-automation-crm/
Summary: We set up CRM pipelines, lead routing and automatic follow-ups so no enquiry is missed. Plain-English help for small and growing businesses.

# Replace scattered leads and manual admin with one organised pipeline.
We build CRM and automation systems that capture every enquiry, keep your team on the same page and take care of the repetitive follow-up.
A CRM is a tool that keeps your customers and enquiries in one place. AI automation makes that tool do routine work for you. It can reply to new enquiries, pass them to the right person and send follow-up reminders.

## Growth stalls when leads and follow-up live in too many places.
Many teams juggle spreadsheets, shared inboxes, chat apps and separate tools. Replies slow down, opportunities get missed, the same work is done twice and nobody can see the full picture. We bring it all into one organised system.

## Less admin, more selling.
We design CRM and automation systems that remove manual bottlenecks. Every enquiry is captured and every interaction is recorded, so nothing is forgotten. Your team can spend its time on decisions instead of data entry.
- Quicker replies to new leads
- Steadier follow-up
- A clear owner for every lead
- Lead sources you can trace
- Easier teamwork
- A tidier customer database
- Less manual work
- A live view of the pipeline
- Reports you can rely on
- Processes that grow with you

## Everything in the build.
Exact scope is agreed for each project and fitted to the tools you already use.

## Where teams put it to work.

## From first review to a system your team actually uses.

### Review
We look at how leads move today: your tools, your data and where the gaps are.

### Plan
We agree stages, fields, owners, rules and the reports you will need.

### Build
We set up the CRM, connect your tools and create automations, dashboards and permissions.

### Test
We run real scenarios and check fallback rules, alerts and data accuracy before launch.

### Train and refine
We write it down, train your team and keep tuning as you use it.

## Built around the software you already run.
Names appear for compatibility only and do not suggest any partnership.

## Common questions about AI automation and CRM.
What we set up, what stays with your team and how migration works.

### Do we need a new CRM?
Not always. We review the tools you already use. If your current CRM does the job we improve it, and if it does not we help you choose one that fits how you sell.

### Can you connect our website forms, ads and WhatsApp to the CRM?
Yes, where the tools offer a dependable connection. New enquiries from forms, ad platforms and messaging apps can be captured in one pipeline automatically.

### What can be automated?
Typical examples are lead capture, assigning leads to the right person, follow-up messages, appointment reminders, sales tasks, new-customer onboarding and weekly reports.

### Will automation replace our sales team?
No. Automation handles repetitive steps such as copying data and sending reminders. Your team keeps the conversations and decisions that need a person.

### Can you move our data from spreadsheets or an old system?
Yes. We clean the data, remove duplicates and migrate it into the new setup. We agree how fields map across before anything is moved.

### Do you train our team?
Yes. We run training sessions and leave written guides so your team knows how each automation works and who owns each step.

Page title: AI Chatbots & Voice Agents | Pacific Marketing Solution
Address: https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/services/ai-chatbots-voice-agents/
Summary: AI chatbots and voice agents that answer customer questions on your website, WhatsApp and phone, and book appointments around the clock.

# Answer every question, day or night, and book the next step.
We build chat and voice assistants for your website, WhatsApp and phone line. They reply instantly, collect the details you need and hand over to your team when a person is needed.
An AI chatbot is a virtual assistant that answers customer questions by text on your website or WhatsApp. A voice agent does the same on the phone. Both can book appointments and hand tricky questions to a person.

## Customers wait, and then they leave.
Questions arrive after hours, on several channels and in a rush. When nobody answers quickly, people move on, and your team spends its day on the same simple questions.

## Always-on answers, with people in the loop.
We build chat and voice assistants that handle common questions, gather the details your team needs and book appointments. Whenever a conversation needs a person, the assistant hands it over with the full history, so nothing is lost between channels.
- Replies in seconds, day or night
- Fewer missed enquiries
- Shorter queues for your team
- Answers that stay consistent
- Bookings without back-and-forth
- Details captured before handover
- One record for every conversation
- Support in more than one language
- Insight into what customers ask
- Easy to update as your business changes

## Everything in the build.
Exact scope is agreed for each project and fitted to your channels, tools and tone of voice.

## Where businesses put assistants to work.

## From your questions to an assistant customers trust.

### Collect
We gather your FAQs, policies, tone of voice and the questions customers ask most.

### Design
We map the conversations, set what the assistant may and may not say, and plan handovers.

### Build
We create the assistants, connect your calendar, CRM and channels, and load your knowledge.

### Test
We try real questions, edge cases and handovers, and fix the gaps before launch.

### Launch and refine
We go live, review conversations together and keep improving the answers.

## Connected to the channels and tools you already use.
Names appear for compatibility only and do not suggest any partnership.

## Common questions about chatbots and voice agents.
Straight answers on channels, accuracy, handover and setup.

### What is the difference between a chatbot and a voice agent?
A chatbot answers in text on your website or in messaging apps such as WhatsApp. A voice agent talks with people on the phone. Both can draw on the same knowledge base, so customers get consistent answers on every channel.

### Can the assistant book appointments?
Yes. We connect it to your calendar so it can offer free times, confirm the booking and send reminders. What it can do depends on the calendar tool you use, and we confirm that during planning.

### What happens when the assistant cannot answer a question?
It tells the customer it needs a person, collects their contact details and hands the conversation to your team with the full history. We agree the rules for when to hand over before launch.

### How do you keep the assistant from giving wrong answers?
Answers come from content you approve, and we set limits on what the assistant may say. We test it with real customer questions before launch and review conversations afterwards so gaps can be fixed.

### Which channels and languages can it support?
We can set up website chat, WhatsApp and phone. Language support depends on the channel and the AI model used, and we confirm the languages you need during planning.

### Can the assistant connect to our CRM?
Yes. Where a reliable connection exists, conversations and new contacts can be sent to your CRM so your team sees every enquiry in one place.

### How long does it take to launch an assistant?
It depends on the channels, the amount of content and the tools involved. After a discovery call we give you an estimate based on your scope.

Page title: Performance Marketing & Ads | Pacific Marketing Solution
Address: https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/services/performance-marketing-funnels/
Summary: Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns built around cost per qualified lead, with landing pages, tracking and clear weekly reports.

# Spend on ads that lead to real enquiries, not just clicks.
We plan campaigns, build the landing pages they point to and track every step, so you can see which spend brings in qualified leads.
Performance marketing is paid advertising that you judge by results, such as enquiries or sales, not by views. You track what each lead costs and put more money into what works.

## Ads only work when everything behind them does too.
Campaigns fall short when the offer, creative, landing page, tracking and follow-up are not working together. We look at the whole customer journey, not just the ad spend.

## Where your customers already spend their time.
We plan paid social, search and retargeting as one funnel, so the offer, creative and tracking stay consistent on every platform.

### Meta Ads
Audience targeting and lead forms across Facebook and Instagram

### Instagram
Reels and Stories creative made to fit the feed

### Google Ads
Search, Shopping and Performance Max campaigns

### LinkedIn
Reach decision-makers by job role and company

### TikTok
Short vertical video built for fast attention

### YouTube
Video campaigns that introduce and retarget

### Channels in one funnel
Paid social, search and video are planned together, with one offer and one set of tracking.

### Funnel steps tracked
From audience chosen to result tracked, so you can see exactly where leads drop off.

### Core metrics reported
Return on ad spend, cost per lead, landing page conversion and speed to first follow-up.

### Reporting rhythm
A plain-language report on spend, leads and cost per lead, every week.
These figures describe how we work, not results. Targets are agreed after a discovery call, and no fixed result is guaranteed.

## One system from the first click to the booked call.
We link advertising strategy with landing pages built to convert and automatic follow-up. Every step of the funnel is tracked, so spend turns into qualified enquiries you can measure.
- A clear view of campaign performance
- A focus on lead quality
- Landing pages built to convert
- Smarter budget decisions
- A closer link between marketing and sales
- More relevant traffic
- Stronger creative testing
- Tracking you can rely on
- Faster learning from every round
- Less money spent on empty clicks

## Works with the ad, tracking and CRM tools you already use.
Names appear for compatibility only and do not suggest any partnership.

## Common questions about performance marketing and funnels.
Platforms, budgets, tracking and what we can and cannot promise.

### Which advertising platforms do you work with?
We work with platforms such as Meta, Google, LinkedIn and TikTok. We recommend where to advertise based on where your customers spend their time and what you sell.

### Who decides the ad budget?
You do. We advise on how to divide it between campaigns and platforms, and your ad spend is paid directly to the platforms.

### How do you measure success?
We agree the goals first, usually cost per qualified lead and booked appointments, and revenue where your data allows. We set up tracking before launch so each result can be traced.

### Do you build the landing pages too?
Yes. Each campaign points to a page built for one clear action, so the message in the ad matches what visitors see after they click.

### How soon will we see results?
Early signals usually appear once enough data has been collected, but timing depends on your market, budget and offer. We test in rounds and report clearly as data comes in.

### Do you guarantee leads or sales?
No. Nobody can honestly promise a specific number of leads or sales. We promise clear tracking, honest reporting and steady testing so decisions are based on data.

Page title: SEO, AEO & GEO Services | Pacific Marketing Solution
Address: https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/services/seo-aeo-geo/
Summary: SEO, AEO and GEO explained simply: rank in search, win direct answers and get mentioned by AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity.

# Be the business that search engines and AI assistants recommend.
We help your website rank in search results. We also help AI answer tools understand and mention your business. People can then find you when they search, ask a question or chat with an assistant.
SEO helps your website show up in search results. AEO (answer engine optimization) helps your content be chosen as the direct answer to a question. GEO (generative engine optimization) helps AI assistants such as ChatGPT or Gemini find, understand and mention your business.

## Search has changed, and many websites have not.
People now get answers from search results, AI summaries and chat assistants. Pages built only around keywords often go unseen, and AI tools skip content they cannot easily understand or trust.

## One strategy for classic search and AI answers.
We fix the technical basics and write for the questions your customers ask. We also add labels called structured data, so search engines and AI tools can understand your content. Then we track where you appear and keep improving.
- Stronger rankings for the searches that matter
- Pages that answer real customer questions
- A site search engines can crawl and index
- Clear structured data about your business
- A better chance of being cited by AI tools
- Consistent business details across the web
- Local visibility where it applies
- Reports that show visibility, not just traffic

## What we do for you.

### Technical fixes

### Content and answers

### Structured data and AI visibility

### Tracking and reporting

## Where this service is used.

## From first audit to visibility you can measure.

### Audit
We review your site, your search results and how AI tools describe your business today.

### Research
We find the keywords, questions and topics your customers actually use.

### Fix
We repair technical issues so your pages can be crawled, indexed and understood.

We add structured data and consistent business details so machines understand you.

### Measure and improve
We track rankings, search traffic and AI answers, then refine each round.

## Works with the search and AI tools you already use.
Names appear for compatibility only and do not suggest any partnership.

## Common questions about SEO, AEO and GEO.
What each one means, what we do and what we cannot promise.

### What are SEO, AEO and GEO?
SEO helps your pages rank in search results. AEO shapes your content so it can be chosen as the direct answer in featured snippets and voice assistants. GEO improves how AI tools such as chat assistants and AI summaries find, understand and cite your business.

### Do I need all three?
They overlap. Clear technical foundations and helpful content support all three, so we usually plan them together and put the most effort where your customers are searching.

### How is GEO different from SEO?
SEO focuses on ranking pages. GEO focuses on whether AI tools describe your business correctly and mention it in their answers. That depends on clear content, structured data and consistent details across the web.

### Can you guarantee a number one ranking or AI mentions?
No. Search engines and AI tools change often and nobody controls them. We promise a clear plan, honest reporting and steady improvement based on data.

### How long does it take to see results?
Search and AI visibility build gradually and depend on your market, competition and current site. We track progress in rounds and report what is changing as data comes in.

### Can you work on our existing website?
Yes. We start with an audit of what you have, fix the biggest problems and improve pages instead of rebuilding everything.

### How do you measure success?
We track rankings, search impressions and clicks, enquiries from search, and regular checks of how AI tools answer questions about your business.

# Turn your data into decisions your team can act on.

AI analytics and data intelligence means collecting your business data from different tools, preparing it, and presenting it as dashboards, reports, forecasts and search tools that support decisions. AI is used where it helps, for example to summarize results, search documents or spot trends.

## Data spread across tools does not help anyone decide.
Numbers sit in spreadsheets, ad accounts, CRMs and databases, and each report tells a slightly different story. Reports take days to prepare, nobody is sure which figure is right, and the questions that matter most go unanswered.

## One reliable view of your business, built around your questions.

## Common questions about AI analytics and data intelligence.
Data sources, dashboards, forecasts and security.

### What is AI analytics and data intelligence?
It means connecting your data sources, preparing the data, and turning it into dashboards, reports, forecasts and search tools that help you make decisions. AI is used where it helps, for example to summarize results or search documents.

### Which data sources can you connect?
Common business sources such as CRMs, ad platforms, websites, spreadsheets, databases and other systems with an API or export. We confirm what is possible after reviewing your tools.

### Do you build dashboards or only reports?
Both. We build live dashboards for day-to-day decisions and scheduled reports for regular reviews, depending on how your team works.

### How accurate are the predictions?
Predictions depend on the quality and amount of your data. We explain what a forecast is based on, show how far it can be trusted and do not promise exact outcomes.

### What are vector and graph databases used for?
Vector databases help AI tools find similar documents or answers by meaning. Graph databases store how people, products or records connect. We recommend them only when your use case needs them.

### Who owns the data and the dashboards?
Your data remains yours. Ownership and access to the dashboards, code and accounts are agreed in your contract and confirmed before work starts.

### How do you keep the data secure?
We limit access to the people who need it, agree where the data is stored and follow the security requirements you tell us about. Details are agreed for each project.

### Questions and answers on this page
Q: What is AI analytics and data intelligence?
A: It means connecting your data sources, preparing the data, and turning it into dashboards, reports, forecasts and search tools that help you make decisions. AI is used where it helps, for example to summarize results or search documents.

Q: Which data sources can you connect?
A: Common business sources such as CRMs, ad platforms, websites, spreadsheets, databases and other systems with an API or export. We confirm what is possible after reviewing your tools.

Q: Do you build dashboards or only reports?
A: Both. We build live dashboards for day-to-day decisions and scheduled reports for regular reviews, depending on how your team works.

Q: How accurate are the predictions?
A: Predictions depend on the quality and amount of your data. We explain what a forecast is based on, show how far it can be trusted and do not promise exact outcomes.

Q: What are vector and graph databases used for?
A: Vector databases help AI tools find similar documents or answers by meaning. Graph databases store how people, products or records connect. We recommend them only when your use case needs them.

Q: Who owns the data and the dashboards?
A: Your data remains yours. Ownership and access to the dashboards, code and accounts are agreed in your contract and confirmed before work starts.

Q: How do you keep the data secure?
A: We limit access to the people who need it, agree where the data is stored and follow the security requirements you tell us about. Details are agreed for each project.

Page title: API & Systems Integration | Pacific Marketing Solution
Address: https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/services/api-systems-integration/
Summary: REST APIs, CRM and payment integrations, webhooks and data synchronization that connect your systems so data moves without manual copying.

# Systems that talk to each other, so your team stops copying data.
We build APIs and integrations that connect your CRM, payment gateway, website, AI tools and internal systems, so information flows automatically and stays consistent.
API and systems integration means connecting separate software systems, such as your CRM, website, payment gateway and AI tools, so data moves between them automatically and consistently instead of being copied by hand.

## Disconnected systems create manual work and mistakes.
When your website, CRM, payment tool and back-office systems do not talk to each other, people copy and paste data between them. Records go out of date, orders and leads are missed, and nobody is sure which system is right.

## Reliable connections between your tools, with clear error handling.
We map how data should flow, build the API connections, webhooks and synchronization, and test them with real data. We add logging and alerts so failures are noticed, and we document the integration so it can be maintained.
- Less manual copying and re-entry
- One consistent record across systems
- Faster follow-up on leads and orders
- Payments connected to customer data
- AI features added to your existing tools
- Failures logged and flagged
- Documented integrations your team can maintain
- Room to connect more systems later

## What we can build for you.
Choose the parts you need. The scope is agreed for each project.

### Integrations

### Data movement

### AI connections

### Reliability

### Design

### Build

## Works with the platforms and tools you already use.
Names appear for compatibility only and do not suggest any partnership.

## Common questions about API and systems integration.
APIs, webhooks, AI connections and reliability.

### What is an API integration?
An API integration connects two systems so they exchange data automatically. For example, a website form can create a contact in your CRM, or a payment can update a customer record.

### What is a webhook?
A webhook is a message one system sends to another when something happens, such as a new order or form submission. It lets systems react straight away instead of checking over and over.

### Which systems can you connect?
Systems that offer an API, webhooks or data export, such as CRMs, payment gateways, websites, AI services and many business tools. We confirm what is possible after reviewing your tools.

### Can you build an API for our own product?
Yes. We design and build REST APIs with authentication, documentation and error handling, so other systems or apps can use your product safely.

### Can you add AI to our existing tools?
Often yes, by connecting AI services through their APIs to your CRM, website or workflow. We explain what the AI will do, what data it uses and where a person should review the result.

### What happens if an integration fails?
We build in logging, alerts and retries where appropriate, so failures are noticed and handled. The monitoring and support arrangement is agreed for each project.

### Is our data kept secure during integration?
We use secure connections and limit access to the data each connection needs. We follow the security requirements you tell us about, and details are agreed for each project.

# Reliable hosting and deployment for your websites and software.
We set up and look after the servers, deployment pipelines, monitoring and backups behind your websites and applications, so they stay available, secure and easy to update.
Cloud, DevOps and infrastructure means setting up and looking after the servers, deployment processes, monitoring and backups that keep websites and applications running, secure and easy to update.

## A site that goes down or cannot be updated safely costs you customers.
Servers set up by hand, updates made directly on live sites and no backups mean small problems become outages. Nobody is alerted when something fails, and recovering from a mistake or an attack takes far longer than it should.

## Infrastructure that is set up properly, monitored and recoverable.
We set up your servers or cloud environment, containerize applications where useful, automate testing and deployment, and add monitoring and backups. We configure SSL, domains and DNS, manage secrets and access, and document how everything works.
- Fewer outages and faster fixes
- Safer, repeatable deployments
- Alerts before customers notice problems
- Backups and a recovery plan
- Faster, more stable performance
- Secrets and access under control
- Room to scale as traffic grows
- Clear documentation of your setup

## Works with the platforms and tools you already use.

## Common questions about cloud, DevOps and infrastructure.
Deployment, servers, backups, security and scaling.

### What is DevOps?
DevOps is a way of building and running software that automates testing, deployment and monitoring, so updates are safer, faster and repeatable.

### What does cloud deployment mean?
It means running your website or application on cloud or virtual servers instead of a single machine managed by hand, so it can be set up, updated and scaled in a controlled way.

### Can you manage our existing server?
Often yes. We start by reviewing how it is set up, secured and backed up, then agree what to fix and what ongoing management you want.

### What is CI/CD?
CI/CD is an automated process that tests your code and deploys it to your servers when it is ready, replacing risky manual updates.

### What happens if the site goes down?
With uptime monitoring, you or we are alerted quickly, and with backups and a recovery plan service can be restored. The response arrangements are agreed for each project.

### How do you keep servers secure?
We limit access, keep software updated, protect secrets and passwords, and configure firewalls and SSL. We follow the security requirements you tell us about, and details are agreed for each project.

### Can you help us handle more traffic?
Yes. We review performance, add caching and optimization, and plan scaling options so the site can handle growth without paying for capacity it does not need.

<!-- https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/glossary/ -->
Page title: Marketing Terms Explained | Pacific Marketing Solution
Address: https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/glossary/
Summary: Plain-English meanings of common marketing words such as SEO, AEO, GEO, CRM, CTR, CPC, conversion, funnel and white-label.

# Marketing terms explained in plain English.
Short, simple meanings for the words you will hear when you work with a marketing team.

## Finding you online

### SEO (Search Engine Optimization)
The work of helping your website appear higher in search results such as Google, so more people find you without paying for ads.

### AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)
Writing and organising your content so search tools can pick it as the direct answer to a question, for example in a featured snippet or a voice assistant reply.

### GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)
Making your business easy for AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity to find, understand and mention when people ask them questions.

### Keyword
A word or phrase people type into a search box, such as "dent repair near me".

### Indexing
When a search engine adds your page to its list of pages it can show. A page that is not indexed cannot appear in search results.

### Organic traffic
Visitors who find your website through unpaid search results.

### Structured data (schema)
Hidden labels in a web page that tell search engines and AI tools what the page is about, such as a business address or a list of questions and answers.

## Reading the numbers

### Impression
One time your page or ad is shown to someone.

### Click-through rate (CTR)
The share of people who clicked after seeing your page or ad. If 100 people see it and 3 click, the click-through rate is 3%.

### Average position
Where your page typically appears in search results. Position 1 is the top, and positions 11 to 20 are usually on the second page.

### Conversion
A valuable action a visitor takes, such as sending a form, calling you or booking a meeting.

### Conversion rate
The share of visitors who convert. If 200 people visit and 10 send a form, the conversion rate is 5%.

## Advertising

### Cost per click (CPC)
What you pay each time someone clicks your ad.

### Cost per conversion
Your total ad spend divided by the number of conversions. It tells you what each enquiry or sale costs you.

### Landing page
The page a person arrives on after clicking an ad or link, built to get them to take one action.

### Funnel
The steps a person goes through from first seeing your business to becoming a customer.

### Performance marketing
Paid advertising that is measured by results, such as leads or sales, instead of views.

## Tools and ways of working

### CRM (Customer Relationship Management)
Software that keeps your customers, enquiries and follow-ups in one place so nothing is forgotten.

### Automation
Setting software to do routine tasks for you, such as sending a reply or reminding you to follow up.

### AI assistant or chatbot
A program that answers questions in everyday language, on a website, in WhatsApp or on the phone.

### White-label
Work done by one company and delivered under another company's brand name.
Related services: SEO, AEO & GEO Performance marketing and funnels AI automation and CRM White-label services

## Ready to talk it through?
Tell us what you are trying to achieve and we will suggest where to begin.

Page title: Low Cost Per Click: Why Conversion Tracking Matters
Address: https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/insights/a-low-cost-per-click-needs-conversion-tracking/
Summary: A $0.78 click sounds cheap, but is it working? Learn why cost per click needs conversion tracking, using a real Google Ads campaign.

# A $0.78 click is only good news if you can see what happens next
Allen Jacobi Law's campaign delivered 717 clicks for $558. Why cost per click alone cannot judge it.
2 min read · Based on: Allen Jacobi Law, Naples Dent Away

## At a glance
Allen Jacobi Law's campaign was shown 24.3K times and earned 717 clicks, a click-through rate of about 3% (calculated), at an average of $0.78 per click. For $558 in total, that is efficient outreach and targeted visibility.

## Do not compare cost per click across businesses
In another campaign we ran for a dent repair service, the average click cost about $2.89, almost four times as much. The two businesses sell different services in different markets, so the click prices are not comparable. What counts is the cost of a qualified enquiry.

## What the dashboard did not show
The figures supplied for this campaign cover clicks and spend. They do not include how many visitors contacted the firm. A cheap click that never becomes an enquiry is still wasted money, and an expensive click that becomes a client can be a bargain.

## Setting up the full picture
- Record contact forms, calls and booking requests as conversions in Google Ads.
- Add call tracking if most enquiries come by phone.
- Ask each new enquiry how they found the firm.
- Report cost per qualified enquiry next to cost per click.
Figures come from the Google Ads dashboard screenshots supplied with the project. Calculated figures are marked.

Page title: Meta Ads Objectives: Clicks or Conversations?
Address: https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/insights/clicks-or-conversations-meta-ads-objective/
Summary: How to choose between link clicks and messaging conversations on Meta Ads, with real costs from three industrial-products campaigns.

# Clicks or conversations? Choosing the right Meta Ads objective
Shahid Enterprizes ran three campaigns with different goals, and their numbers cannot be compared directly.
2 min read · Based on: Shahid Enterprizes

## At a glance

### Mega Flecks Industrial Belt
conversations
per conversation
≈ USD 0.080
spend
≈ USD 5.41

### Agro Power Belts (WhatsApp)
link clicks
2,813
per click
≈ USD 0.0024
≈ USD 6.76

### Agro Power Belts (Harvester)
≈ USD 0.109
≈ USD 9.03
Shahid Enterprizes sells industrial belts, where buyers usually want to talk before they buy. We ran three Meta campaigns, and two of them were built to start messaging conversations.

## Different goals, different numbers
The two conversation campaigns produced 68 and 83 conversations, 151 in total, at ≈ USD 0.080 and ≈ USD 0.109 each. The third was a WhatsApp link campaign built for clicks: 2,813 clicks at ≈ USD 0.0024 each. A cost of ≈ USD 0.0024 per click and a cost of ≈ USD 0.079 per conversation measure different things, so putting them in one chart would mislead.

## What the two conversation campaigns show
The Harvester campaign cost about 37% more per conversation than the Mega Flecks campaign (calculated). Across both, the blended cost was about USD 0.096 per conversation (calculated). The cause could be the audience, the product or the creative, and the report does not say which.

## How to choose an objective
- Pick the one result that matters most for each campaign.
- Use a conversation objective when buyers want to ask questions first.
- Use link clicks when you want people on a page, then track what they do there.
- Report every campaign against its own goal.

## What we would do next
- Track how many conversations become quote requests and sales.
- Compare the creative used in the two conversation campaigns.
- Reply quickly: a conversation only has value if someone answers.

<!-- https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/insights/fix-indexing-before-writing-more-content/ -->
Page title: Fix Website Indexing First: A Law Firm SEO Case
Address: https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/insights/fix-indexing-before-writing-more-content/
Summary: Why search engines must index your pages before new content helps, and how fixing indexing for a law firm led to qualified leads by month three.

# Fix indexing first: how the SEO for Allen Jacobi Law began
A strong reputation does not help if search engines cannot index the site. What we fixed first and what followed.
2 min read · Based on: Allen Jacobi Law, Our Village

## At a glance
Allen Jacobi Law is an entertainment law firm with a strong reputation, but its website had indexing issues. Pages that are not indexed cannot appear in search results, so no amount of new content would have helped until that was fixed.

## The order of the work
- Resolve the indexing problems so the right pages could be found and listed.
- Optimise the existing content for the searches clients use.
- Add more long-tail keywords: longer, more specific phrases that match what people really type.
Traffic picked up within a month. By the third month, qualified leads were coming in through organic search.

## Why the order matters
It is tempting to start by writing. But new content on pages that search engines cannot index is wasted effort. Checking indexing first tells you whether the problem is the pages themselves or simply that they are not being found.

## Causes we check
- Pages blocked by robots rules or marked noindex by mistake.
- Duplicate pages or wrong canonical tags.
- Thin or near-empty pages.
- A missing or outdated sitemap.
- Server errors and broken redirects.
These are typical causes, not a description of every site.
Our Village, a parenting services app, had a similar starting point: a good product with poor online visibility. After optimising the website and targeting the right keywords, traffic grew significantly and users started finding the app through organic search.

## What we would do next
- Keep watching the coverage report for new indexing issues.
- Turn the long-tail searches that work into dedicated pages.
- Measure enquiries, not just visits.
Details come from the project notes and the Google Search Console screenshot supplied with the project.

## Keep reading.

# 155,000 link clicks: what three Meta campaigns show about cost per click
Primax Solar Energy's campaigns cost ≈ USD 0.0059 to USD 0.0070 per click, and the biggest campaign was the most expensive.
2 min read · Based on: Primax Solar Energy

## At a glance

### Luxeed Lithium Battery
link clicks
16,030
per click
≈ USD 0.0059

### Galaxy Dual
83,239
≈ USD 0.0070

### Nexa Series
55,899
≈ USD 0.0064
Primax Solar Energy ran three campaigns that together produced 155,168 link clicks.

## The biggest campaign cost the most per click
Galaxy Dual delivered about 54% of all the clicks (83,239) at ≈ USD 0.0070 per click. Luxeed was the cheapest at ≈ USD 0.0059. The gap is around 20% (calculated). A common reason is that as a campaign reaches more people, it moves beyond its cheapest audiences. We do not have the audience data to say whether that happened here.

## A blended figure
Weighting each campaign by its clicks gives a blended cost of about USD 0.0067 per click and a total spend of roughly USD 1,040. Both are calculated from the figures above.

## Traffic is not sales
A link click shows interest, not a purchase. A solar business needs enquiries and quotes, so clicks are the first number to check, not the last.

## What we would do next
- Measure what each campaign produces: quote requests, calls and WhatsApp messages.
- Compare cost per enquiry, not only cost per click.
- Test narrower audiences on the largest campaign.
- Look at why Luxeed's clicks were cheaper and whether that applies to the others.

<!-- https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/insights/reading-a-google-ads-report-beyond-clicks/ -->
Page title: How to Read a Google Ads Report: Clicks to Conversions
Address: https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/insights/reading-a-google-ads-report-beyond-clicks/
Summary: Follow a $1,720 Google Ads campaign from impressions to cost per conversion, and learn why clicks alone do not show whether ads are working.

# Clicks are not results: reading a Google Ads report from click to conversion
A $1,720 campaign for Naples Dent Away, followed step by step from impressions to cost per conversion.
2 min read · Based on: Naples Dent Away

## At a glance
Naples Dent Away, a dent repair service in Naples, Florida, ran a Google Ads campaign to raise its online visibility. Here is how we read the report.

## Step 1: did people see and click the ads?
The ads were shown 25,000 times and got 595 clicks, a click-through rate of about 2.4% (calculated). The click-through rate was strong, so the ads and keywords were reaching the right people.

## Step 2: what did a click cost?
With $1,720 spent across 595 clicks, the average cost per click was about $2.89.

## Step 3: how many clicks became enquiries?
Nine conversions from 595 clicks is a conversion rate of about 1.5% (calculated), or roughly $191 per conversion (calculated). This is the number that decides whether a campaign pays for itself.

## What the report points to
Strong clicks but few conversions means the weak spot is after the click: the landing page, the offer, or how easily a visitor can get in touch. That is why the report named conversion rate optimisation as the clear next area.
Illustration only, not a result: if the same 595 clicks converted at 3% instead of 1.5%, the campaign would produce about 18 conversions and the cost per conversion would fall to about $96. Improving the page can matter more than buying more clicks.

## What we would do next
- Check the landing page on a phone: speed, a call button and a clear next step.
- Track calls and form submissions as conversions.
- Send each ad group to a page that matches the search.
- Review search terms and add negative keywords.
Figures come from the Google Ads dashboard screenshots supplied with the project. Calculated figures are marked.

## Keep reading.

<!-- https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/insights/three-seo-reports-side-by-side/ -->
Page title: How to Read an SEO Report: CTR vs Average Position
Address: https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/insights/three-seo-reports-side-by-side/
Summary: See how three real SEO projects compare on clicks, impressions, click-through rate and average position, and what each number does and does not tell you.

# Three SEO reports side by side: what the numbers show and what they hide
Skin Body Health, Allen Jacobi Law and Pure Hope Weight Loss share a pattern, and an average position that hides a lot.
2 min read · Based on: Skin Body Health, Allen Jacobi Law, Pure Hope Weight Loss
Search Console reports are easy to read as a score: more clicks is good, fewer is bad. Put three of our SEO projects next to each other and the picture gets more interesting.

## At a glance

### Skin Body Health
clicks
216
impressions
7.3K
average CTR
average position
17.5

### Allen Jacobi Law
471
9.85K
4.8%

### Pure Hope Weight Loss
201
3.83K
5.2%
24.5

## 1. The same average position can give different click-through rates
Skin Body Health and Allen Jacobi Law both averaged position 17.5, which is usually the second page of results. One earned a 3% click-through rate and the other 4.8%. Position decides whether people can see you. The title, the description and how closely the page matches the search decide whether they click.

## 2. A lower average position can still come with a high click-through rate
Pure Hope Weight Loss has the lowest average position of the three (24.5) and the highest click-through rate (5.2%). Average position blends every search the site appears for. A handful of well-matched searches ranking near the top can lift the click-through rate while many others sit far down the results. The report we were given does not break this down, so we treat it as a question to investigate, not a conclusion.

## 3. Impressions set the ceiling
Allen Jacobi Law had the most impressions (9.85K) and the most clicks (471). Pure Hope had the fewest impressions (3.83K) and the fewest clicks (201). Clicks follow impressions, so growth means appearing for more of the searches your customers really use. In the Allen Jacobi Law and Pure Hope projects that included adding long-tail keywords, the longer and more specific phrases people type. Skin Body Health started with targeted keywords and fresh content.

## What we would do next with these reports
- Open the query-level report and see which searches produce the clicks.
- Rewrite titles and descriptions on pages with many impressions but few clicks.
- Strengthen pages sitting between positions 11 and 30 with better content and internal links.
- Track enquiries from search, not only clicks.
Figures come from the Google Search Console screenshots supplied with each project.

## Keep reading.

Page title: Voice AI Agents in Practice: Three Builds
Address: https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/insights/voice-ai-agents-three-builds/
Summary: A voice coaching platform, an AI phone receptionist and lead re-engagement calls: what our voice agent builds share, and what to plan first.

# Voice AI agents in practice: three builds and what they share
A coaching platform, a phone receptionist and lead re-engagement calls. What our AI engineer's voice agent projects have in common.
2 min read · Based on: Our AI engineer's Upwork portfolio

## At a glance
- 5 specialist voice coaches behind one manager agent
- 1 call to answer and book an appointment
- 243 automated tests on the Airtime Media agents
Voice agents are among the AI builds businesses ask us about most. Here are three that our AI engineer, Nauman N., has shipped, and the patterns they share.

## The three builds
- Voice coaching platform (FastAPI, React, ElevenLabs, Claude): a manager agent routes each user to one of 5 specialist voice coaches.
- AI phone receptionist (Twilio, FastAPI, Next.js, Claude): answers calls and books appointments during the call.
- Airtime Media voice agents (Twilio, Python): re-engage leads on inbound and outbound calls.

## 1. One job per agent
The coaching platform does not ask one agent to do everything. A manager agent decides which coach the user should talk to, and each of the five coaches covers one area. Smaller jobs are easier to test and to improve one at a time.

## 2. Every call should end in an action
The receptionist does more than answer questions: it books the appointment while the caller is still on the line. The lead re-engagement agents work the same way. The aim of each call is a next step, not just a conversation.

## 3. Automated tests before launch
Phone calls are slow to check by hand, so these builds lean on automated tests. The Airtime Media project is covered by 243 of them.

## Before you build a voice agent
- Write down the one action each call should end with, such as a booking.
- List the systems the agent must read from or write to, such as your calendar or CRM.
- Decide when a call should be handed to a person.
- Plan how you will test it before real customers call.
Based on our AI engineer's Upwork portfolio and project notes. See the full project list on our Work page.

<!-- https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/insights/tech-stack-behind-our-ai-and-saas-builds/ -->
Page title: The Tech Stack Behind Our AI and SaaS Builds
Address: https://pacificmarketingsolution.com/insights/tech-stack-behind-our-ai-and-saas-builds/
Summary: The tools we use to build AI agents, voice agents and SaaS products, from Next.js and FastAPI to Claude, LangGraph, RAG and n8n.

# The tech stack behind our AI and SaaS builds
What we build AI agents, voice agents and SaaS products with, and why each part is there.
2 min read · Based on: Our AI engineer's Upwork profile and portfolio

## At a glance
- 9+ years building software
- 50+ platforms shipped
- 33 projects in his Upwork portfolio
Clients often ask what we build with. This is the stack our AI engineer, Nauman N., uses across the AI and SaaS projects on our Work page, grouped by the job each part does.

## The app people use
Next.js, React and TypeScript for the web app, with FastAPI (Python) or Node.js behind it. PostgreSQL or Supabase store the data. Stripe handles payments and subscriptions, as in the pet care booking marketplace and the custom GPT community platform.

## The AI layer
The Claude API and the OpenAI API handle language tasks, with LangChain and LangGraph running the agents. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with a vector database lets an AI answer from your own documents. In the legal research platform it runs on a self-hosted model, so client documents never reach a third-party API. MCP gives agents a standard way to use tools.

## Voice
ElevenLabs, Vapi, Retell AI and Twilio power voice agents and phone calls, such as the AI phone receptionist that books appointments during the call.

## Automation and CRM
n8n, Make and Zapier connect apps. GoHighLevel, HubSpot and Airtable hold leads and customer records. The Shipbling project, for example, uses n8n workflows to automate a Shopify store.

## Hosting and quality
Docker and AWS for hosting, with automated tests on the larger builds: 93 on the OrbitOS profit dashboard and 243 on the Airtime Media voice agents.

## What we look at when choosing
- The tools your team already uses.
- Keeping your data in systems you own.
- The simplest setup that does the job, with agents only where they save real work.
Based on our AI engineer's Upwork profile and portfolio, October 2026.
